Krishnan Nair]] | hq_location_city = Mumbai | hq_location_country = India | key_people = | industry = [[Hospitality]] | products = [[Hotels]] and [[resorts]] | revenue = {{INRConvert|714|c}} (2017) | owner = [[Brookfield Asset Management]] | website = {{url|https://www.theleela.com/}} }} '''The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts''' is an Indian luxury [[hotel chain]] founded in 1986 by [[C. P. Krishnan Nair]] and currently owned by [[Brookfield Asset Management]].{{Cite news|last=Philip|first=Lijee|title=CP Krishnan Nair: The man who started a career when most think of retirement|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/cp-krishnan-nair-the-man-who-started-a-career-when-most-think-of-retirement/articleshow/35271717.cms|access-date=2020-12-27}} ==History== The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts were founded as part of [[The Leela Group]], which was named after the founder [[C. P. Krishnan Nair]]'s wife. Capt. Nair bought 11 acres of land near his house in [[Sahar Village, Mumbai]] to build his first hotel, The Leela Mumbai, in 1986. It was the first [[Luxury resorts|luxury]] hotel near the current [[Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport]].{{cite web|title=Introduction and History|url=https://www.theleela.com/the-leela/about-the-leela/?tab=2|website=www.theleela.com|access-date=1 September 2016}} To market the hotel better, Nair joined hands with the [[Penta Hotels|Penta]] group, owned by a consortium of European airlines. The hotel was thus named Leela Penta, for a brief period, before being renamed to Leela Kempinski, and ultimately back to Leela Mumbai. The Penta group owned the [[Kempinski]] hotel chain at that time.{{cite web |last1=Sanghvi |first1=Vir |title=Hotel Leela's Captain Courageous |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/hotel-leela-s-captain-courageous/story-0H6p6PhFbYHjWogFy2SSLI.html |website=Hindustan Times |access-date=8 July 2026 |language=en |date=12 February 2011}} Headquartered in Mumbai, The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts is owned by a Brookfield Asset Management-sponsored private real estate fund and operates twelve award-winning properties in major cities and leisure destinations across India. These include the flagship hotel in the capital city of New Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, Udaipur, Jaipur, Gurugram, East Delhi, Mumbai, Gandhinagar, Kovalam and Ashtamudi. In 2001, the group's first modern hotel was built with 357 rooms in the IT capital of India, Bangalore, inspired by the [[Mysore Palace]] and the architecture of the 13th century [[Vijayanagara]] empire, and is surrounded by seven acres of gardens.{{Cite web |title=How many rooms in leela palace delhi? |url=https://lotcottages.com/how-many-rooms-in-leela-palace-delhi}} By 2009, two more properties were added to this portfolio: The Leela Palace in [[Udaipur]] ([[Rajasthan]]) and The Leela Ambience [[Gurgaon]]. [[File:Airport road Bangalore.jpg|thumb|The Leela Palace, [[Bangalore]]]] [[File:The Leela Palace Chennai.jpg|thumb|The Leela Palace, [[Chennai]]]] The Leela Ambience [[Gurgaon]] Hotel & Residences is the group's first non-owned, managed property. The Leela Palace New Delhi opened in April 2011; the palace is inspired by Sir [[Edwin Lutyens]] Delhi.{{Cite web |title=Best of the Best 2012: Hotels: The Leela Palace New Delhi |date=19 May 2023 |url=https://robbreport.com/travel/destinations/best-of-the-best-2012-hotels-the-leela-palace-new-delhi-228606/}} The group opened a new hotel in [[Chennai]] in 2013 called The Leela Palace Chennai. The second Managed hotel was taken over in year 2015, in East Delhi, The Leela Ambience Convention Hotel.{{Cite web |title=When was Leela Udaipur built? |date=26 September 2023 |url=https://www.rampfesthudson.com/when-was-leela-udaipur-built/}} In 2021, the group further expanded its portfolio with three new hotels; The Leela Palace Jaipur, The Leela Gandhinagar and The Leela Bhartiya City Bengaluru.{{Cite web|url=https://hospitality.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/hotels/leela-to-open-up-three-more-properties-in-2021/81424210|title=Leela to open up three more properties in 2021|website=ETHospitalityWorld.com}} There are plans to open new hotels in Hyderabad, Sikkim and Agra. The brand has marketing alliances with US-based [[Preferred Hotels and Resorts]] and is a member of [[Global Hotel Alliance]] based in Dubai.{{Cite news |title=Hotel Leela to soon announce global foray with a deal in Dubai |newspaper=The Economic Times |date=7 April 2013 |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/hotels-/-restaurants/hotel-leela-to-soon-announce-global-foray-with-a-deal-in-dubai/articleshow/19426302.cms}} A previous marketing alliance with Swiss-based [[Kempinski]] ended in October 2013.{{Cite web |title=Leela snaps marketing, branding ties with Kempinski| url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/leela-snaps-marketing-branding-ties-with-kempinski/article5210658.ece| date=7 October 2013| access-date=9 January 2023| author=| website=thehindu.com}} In a deal in October 2019, the company sold its hotel properties and operations as well as hotel assets located in New Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, Udaipur to Canada-based [[Brookfield Asset Management]], in an INR 3,950 crore settlement, marking the entry of Brookfield in India’s hospitality market.{{Cite web|title=Hotel Leelaventure Limited completes sale transaction with Brookfield|url=https://www.theleela.com/the-leela/media/press-releases/hotel-leelaventure-limited-completes-sale-transaction-with-brookfield/|access-date=2021-08-24|website=www.theleela.com}}{{Cite web|last=Sapam|first=Bidya|date=2019-10-22|title=Hotel Leelaventure completes sale of assets to Brookfield|url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/hotel-leelaventure-completes-sale-of-assets-to-brookfield-11571754320592.html|access-date=2021-08-24|website=mint|language=en}}{{Cite news|date=2019-10-26|title=Most beautiful 5-star hotel in Udaipur, Leela gets sold, Brookfield purchases for 2.13 billion|url=https://english.newstracklive.com/news/brookfield-purchased-5-star-hotel-leela-in-udaipur-mc23-nu-1044672-1.html|access-date=2021-08-24|website=News Track|language=English}} [[ITC Limited|ITC]] Group had objected to the sale of Leela owned hotels citing reasons of misappropriation of funds in the sale transaction which was led by the consortium of banks and also due to the fact the interests of minority shareholders were overlooked, and other bids submitted by interested bidders were not considered by [[JM Financial]], the asset reconstruction company in Mumbai. The Securities Appellate Tribunal in September 2019 rejected the petition of ITC clearing the way for Brookfield to acquire the hotels.{{Cite news|last1=Vyas|first1=Maulik|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/hotels-/-restaurants/sat-throws-out-itc-plea-against-leela-brookfield-deal/articleshow/71317103.cms?from=mdr|title=SAT ends Leela over asset deal with Brookfield, for Now|date=2019-09-27|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2020-04-19|last2=Zachariah|first2=Reena}} In addition to ITC, there were other suitors for the Leela Hotels & Resorts, including that of [[Habtoor Hospitality|Rashid Al-Habtoor]] a UAE businessman jointly with an [[Arms dealer|Arms Dealer]] [[Abhishek Verma (arms dealer)|Abhishek Verma]]{{Citation|title=Happy birthday Abhishek Verma cake cutting with Nair family ~ February 23, 2020| date=29 February 2020 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5KINsGHlXsY |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/varchive/youtube/20211213/5KINsGHlXsY |archive-date=2021-12-13 |url-status=live|language=en|access-date=2020-04-19}}{{cbignore}} who submitted their bid of US$600 million in January 2019 however their bids were not entertained and questions were raised on the conduct of JM Financial in this sale transaction.{{Cite web|url=https://www.outlookindia.com/newsscroll/jm-fin-arc-conduct-in-leela-saga-questionable-ians-exclusive/1522548|title=JM FIN ARC conduct in Leela saga questionable (IANS Exclusive)|website=outlookindia.com|access-date=2020-04-19}} In June 2026, it opened The Leela Coorg Forest Sanctuary in [[Madikeri]], [[Tamil Nadu]].{{cite web |last1=Mukherjee |first1=Sumana |title=Wellness and wilderness offer an antidote to city life at this new Coorg resort |url=https://www.cntraveller.in/story/leela-coorg-forest-sanctuary/ |website=Condé Nast Traveller India |access-date=8 July 2026 |language=en-IN |date=26 June 2026}} ==Business structure== ''The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts'' is the trading name of ''Leela Palaces and Resorts Limited''.{{cite web|title=Leela Hotels: Company Information|url=https://www.theleela.com/the-leela/about-the-leela/company-information/|website=Leela Hotels|access-date=11 March 2016}} ''Hotel Leelaventure Limited'' is the ultimate [[holding company]] of the hotel group, and is traded on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] ({{Bombay Stock Exchange|500193}}) and [[National Stock Exchange of India]] ({{nse|HLVLTD}}). Hotel Leelaventure Limited is itself part of [[The Leela Group]] business [[Conglomerate (company)|conglomerate]]. ==Awards== * Travel + Leisure USA World’s Best Awards – The Leela Palaces, Hotels and
